notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {9}{U}{U/R}{U/R}{R}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, mutating it on top of Rootha.
When Lore Drakkis enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Lore Drakkis
uses.cardState: mutated on top of or below Rootha
